claims.description: Images use supported width and height attributes for intrinsic sizing.

notes.text: Image width and height attributes are presentational hints. Their ratio supplies the pre-load fallback; loaded natural dimensions supply the intrinsic size and preferred natural ratio. Missing dimensions remain zero for images without a resource.

claims.description: Images, SVG, and canvas derive automatic dimensions from intrinsic ratios before Taffy layout.

notes.text: Coverage includes loaded PNG natural sizes, image attribute ratio hints, SVG viewBox and numeric dimensions, canvas bitmap dimensions, one-axis CSS sizing, min/max constraints, flex/grid placement, calculated dimensions, authored ratio overrides, and definite border-box dimensions.

Taffy 0.14 has no separate natural content-box ratio. Definite border-box constraints are translated to content-box constraints before layout. Image resource load/error events invalidate geometry without requiring an attribute mutation.

The host must supply decoded image dimensions; the shim does not fetch resources. SVG shapes and canvas pixels have no separate geometry/hit-testing model. SVG attribute lengths beyond numeric/px values and natural-ratio border-box sizing with unresolved percentage constraints are not modeled.

claims.description: `svg`, `canvas`, `video`, `iframe`, and empty `object` elements use deterministic fallback dimensions.

notes.text: SVG without intrinsic dimensions or a valid viewBox, canvas without dimensions, video, iframe, and empty object elements use 300x150 fallback dimensions with supported attribute overrides.
`object` elements without `type` or `data` resource hints lay out fallback children.

claims.description: `audio` elements distinguish non-rendered media from controls with deterministic fallback geometry.

notes.text: `audio` elements without `controls` are non-rendered; audio controls use native `300x54` fallback dimensions.

claims.description: Package metadata can provide deterministic intrinsic dimensions for any element.

notes.text: Any element can use `data-layout-width` and `data-layout-height` metadata.
